title: AlphaFold2 and ProteinMPNN redesign a de novo helical barrel enzyme
summary: AlphaFold2-guided RosettaRemodel designed a truncated variant of the de novo six-helical barrel 6H5L whose crystal structure closely matches the design model. ProteinMPNN redesign gave a variant with a tenfold increase in soluble yield in Escherichia coli, and both variants kept the barrel fold, high thermal stability and catalytic activity. Results are from a single scaffold in a Research Square preprint.
